steps.assert: (() => new Promise(res => { const img = new Image(); img.onerror = () => res('image illisible'); img.onload = () => { const v = document.querySelector('#review-video'); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.naturalWidth; c.height = img.naturalHeight; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let bleu = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] < 80 && d[i + 1] < 80 && d[i + 2] > 180) bleu++; const taille = c.width === v.videoWidth && c.height === v.videoHeight; res(taille && bleu === 0 ? true : { png: [c.width, c.height], video: [v.videoWidth, v.videoHeight], bleu }); }; img.src = A.state.review.images[0]; }))()

steps.assert: (() => new Promise(res => { const img = new Image(); img.onerror = () => res('image illisible'); img.onload = () => { const v = document.querySelector('#review-video'); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.naturalWidth; c.height = img.naturalHeight; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let bleu = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] < 80 && d[i + 1] < 80 && d[i + 2] > 180) bleu++; const taille = c.width === v.videoWidth && c.height === v.videoHeight; res(taille && bleu > 200 ? true : { png: [c.width, c.height], video: [v.videoWidth, v.videoHeight], bleu }); }; img.src = A.state.review.images[1]; }))()
